changes: FRACT plays three overlapping grains from a Flex sample, with position, size, direction, scatter, shape and stereo SPACE controls.
Use a Flex track with TSTR OFF. One FRACT track can play at a time; other FRACT tracks play dry and show the owner track.
Above SPCE 96, a darker tail and stereo smoothing soften repeated attacks. SPCE 0–96 and grain rendering keep their sound.
After updating an earlier development Part, select FRACT again and reset its defaults; see the README migration notes.
Known issue: grains can remain audible at SPCE 127. SETUP controls take no locks, LFOs or scenes.
